feed.title: Bullpen Phone: Houston Astros reporter posts

entry.title: Houston Astros staff and front office: Brad Ausmus acknowledged that he interviewed for the Astros' GM job before it went to Randy Flores. Ausmus said he left the interview pretty sure he would not be getting the GM job, but was encouraged that he could be in play for the manager's role. Flores was hired the next day.
Yordan Álvarez: Astros designated hitter Yordan Alvarez is the American League MVP. He is the first full-time designated hitter to ever win AL MVP and the third MVP in Astros franchise history.
Isaac Paredes: The Astros exercised Isaac Paredes’ $13.35 million club option.

Houston Astros offseason notes: The Astros added reliever Roddery Muñoz and catcher César Salazar to the 40-man roster, made their trade for pitcher Evan Reifert official and outrighted Jake Meyers off the 40-man roster. Meyers will elect free agency. Houston’s 40-man roster is at 39 players.
Tatsuya Imai: Tatsuya Imai will exercise his $18 million player option and return to the Astros in 2027, source tells @theathletic.com. First: @jonheyman.bsky.social - www.nytimes.com/athletic/773...
Nelson Velázquez: The Astros announced they released Nelson Velázquez so he could pursue an opportunity with a club in Asia.
